title: ProximityPrompt Interactions
summary: The modern 'press E on this' system: ProximityPrompt gives you the hold-to-interact UI for free. Triggered (completed), TriggerEnded (cancelled), server + client flavors, cooldown via ObjectText/HoldDuration.

explanation.whatItIs: Drop a ProximityPrompt on a part and the engine handles range detection, button hints, hold timers, and firing Triggered on the right side of the network.
explanation.whyItExists: Before prompts, every game hand-rolled 'stand near + press key' with different results. One class standardized it.
whenToUse: Doors, chests, shops, NPCs — any interactable in the world
Triggered on the SERVER for authoritative actions (it fires there too)
PromptTriggered (client) for instant feedback + sound while server processes
HoldDuration for deliberate actions; MaxActivationDistance for range
whenNotToUse: Where you need fully custom key handling — but try prompts first
commonMistakes: Handling Triggered only on the client — server never applies the effect
Letting players spam: add cooldown (debounce/cooldown pattern)
Forgetting prompts need an InputType-compatible setup for gamepad/touch — defaults mostly work

examples.title: Chest that opens once
examples.code:
-- Setup (server Script):
local chest = workspace.Chest
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Open"
prompt.ObjectText = "Chest"
prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true
prompt.Parent = chest

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    prompt.Enabled = false          -- one-shot
    giveLoot(player)
    task.delay(60, function()
        prompt.Enabled = true       -- respawn the interaction
    end)
end)
